name: AI Deep Dive — CORZ — 2026-05-02
rationale: Core Scientific (CORZ) has ridden the post-bankruptcy AI/HPC hype wave to a $6.4B valuation. While forward estimates suggest aggressive top-line acceleration as they pivot from pure Bitcoin mining to AI hosting, the capital requirements remain brutal (-$460M FCF). At 20x trailing sales, the market is pricing in flawless execution and ignoring the inevitable shareholder dilution required to fund infrastructure capex. My weighted fair value of $5.71 indicates massive downside risk.

aiThesis.rationale: CORZ is another crypto-miner executing an HPC/AI data center pivot. Emerging from bankruptcy, the stock has surged on retail momentum and the AI infrastructure narrative. However, the economic reality is inescapable: building gigawatt data centers requires billions in capex. Last year, CORZ burned $460M in FCF. Funding the pipeline at a $6.4B market cap guarantees significant equity dilution (modeled at 25% in the base case). Even if they scale to $1.2B in revenue by Year 5 with a 12% net margin, the inflated share count suppresses the present value to $4.53. The current $20.35 price offers zero margin of safety.
